# Robot system

## Robot configuration

::: {.tirrex-story-intro}
The robot configuration files follow the description format introduced by the
ROMEA ecosystem, called **meta-descriptions**. TIRREX uses these files to build
the complete robot system.
:::

::: {.columns .robot-files-overview}
::: {.column width="48%"}
::: {.config-path}
```text
config/
  robot/
    base.yaml
    devices.yaml
    devices/
      *.arm.yaml
      *.gps.yaml
      *.imu.yaml
      *.lidar.yaml
      *.camera.yaml
      *.implement.yaml
```
:::
:::

::: {.column width="52%"}
::: {.highlight-box .robot-files-roles}
- `base.yaml` describes the mobile base
- `devices.yaml` lists devices and filters them by execution mode
- `devices/<name>.<type>.yaml` describes each physical device
- `<type>` selects the corresponding `romea_<type>_meta_bringup` package
- Device files select a model, location, launch profiles and recordable topics
:::
:::
:::

::: {.robot-files-conclusion}
TIRREX selects the components available for the current mode, assembles them
into one robot description and delegates each component to its corresponding
ROMEA meta-bringup package.
:::

## What is a meta-description

::: {.tirrex-story-intro}
A meta-description uses a common structure to identify a component, select its
supported model, describe where it is mounted on the robot, and define how its
drivers and/or controllers are launched.
:::

::: {.columns .meta-description-overview}
::: {.column .meta-description-example width="40%"}
### Generic device meta-description

```yaml
name: front_sensor
namespace: sensors

configuration:
  manufacturer: foo
  model: bar
  version: "1.0"

location:
  parent_link: base_link
  xyz: [0.5, 0.0, 0.8]
  rpy: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0]

launch:
  - node:
      package: foo_driver
      executable: sensor_node
      name: driver
      output: screen
      parameters:
        - frame_id: front_sensor_link

  - include:
      file: other_package/launch/processing.launch.py
```
:::

::: {.column .meta-description-explanation width="60%"}
### Key fields

::: {.highlight-box .meta-fields-box}
- **Identity** — `name` and `namespace` define the component in the robot.
- **Configuration** — `manufacturer`, `model` and `version` select the supported model.
- **Location** — `parent_link`, `xyz` and `rpy` describe where the component is mounted on the robot.
- **Launch** — nodes and included launch files define how its drivers and/or controllers are started.
:::

::: {.meta-description-key}
The same structure is used for mobile bases, sensors, robotic arms and
implements.
:::
:::
:::

## From meta-descriptions to runtime

::: {.tirrex-story-intro}
Each component-specific meta-bringup package reads the meta-description and
generates the files required to integrate the component into the ROS 2 system.
:::

::: {.columns .artifact-generation-overview}
::: {.column .artifact-generation-commands width="64%"}
### Generation commands

```bash
ros2 run romea_<device_type>_meta_bringup generate_configuration_file.py \
  meta_description_file_path:=/path/to/device.yaml > device.yaml

ros2 run romea_<device_type>_meta_bringup generate_controllers_configuration_file.py \
  meta_description_file_path:=/path/to/device.yaml \
  mode:=live robot_namespace:=robot > controllers.yaml

ros2 run romea_<device_type>_meta_bringup generate_urdf_description.py \
  meta_description_file_path:=/path/to/device.yaml \
  mode:=live robot_namespace:=robot > device.urdf

ros2 run romea_<device_type>_meta_bringup generate_launch_file.py \
  meta_description_file_path:=/path/to/device.yaml \
  robot_namespace:=robot > device.launch.yaml
```

### Launch the component

```bash
ros2 launch romea_<device_type>_meta_bringup <device_type>.launch.py \
  meta_description_file_path:=/path/to/device.yaml \
  robot_namespace:=robot mode:=live
```
:::

::: {.column .artifact-generation-results width="36%"}
### Generated artifacts

::: {.runtime-artifacts-box}
- Parameter files
- Controller configuration
- URDF descriptions
- ROS 2 launch files
:::
:::
:::

### TIRREX orchestration

::: {.tirrex-artifact-orchestration}
::: {.tirrex-artifact-step}
**Compose**

Build the complete robot URDF and `ros2_control` description.
:::

::: {.tirrex-artifact-step}
**Delegate**

Call the component-specific ROMEA meta-bringup launch files.
:::

::: {.tirrex-artifact-step}
**Run**

Start drivers, controllers or simulation bridges according to `mode`.
:::
:::

## Mobile base configuration

::: {.columns .config-slide}
::: {.column width="50%"}

#### Configuration file

::: {.config-path}

```text
config/
  robot/
    base.yaml
```

:::

#### Meta-description

```yaml
name: "base"
launch:
  - include:
      file: "$(find-pkg-share romea_mobile_base_meta_bringup)/profile/robot.launch.py"
      if: $(eval "'$(var mode)' == 'live'")
configuration:
  manufacturer: inrae
  model: adap2e
  version: one
records:
  joint_states: true
  controller/odom: true
  controller/odometry: true
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

#### Configurable fields

::: {.config-table}

| Section | Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `launch` | included files | Calls mobile base profiles/files |
| `configuration` | `manufacturer` | Selects supported manufacturer |
| `configuration` | `model` | Selects robot-specific bringup |
| `configuration` | `version` | Selects robot variant (optional) |
| `records` | topic flags | Base topics saved in a bag |

:::

::: {.config-table}

| Supported base manufacturer | Model | Version |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `agilex` | `scout` | `mini` |
| `agilex` | `hunter` | - |
| `agreenculture` | `ceol` | - |
| `clearpath_robotics` | `husky` | - |
| `inrae` | `adap2e` | `one` or  `two`|
| `inrae` | `robucat` | - |
| `robotnik` | `campero` | `rubber` |
| `sabi-agri` | `pom` | `4x4` |
| `xlim` | `cinteo` | - |

:::

::: {.config-table}

| Launch profile | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `robot` | Starts the selected mobile base |
| `localisation_plugin` | Publishes odometry observations |

:::

:::
:::

## Device index configuration

::: {.columns .config-slide}
::: {.column width="50%"}

#### Configuration file

::: {.config-path}

```text
config/
  robot/
    devices.yaml
    devices/
      <name>.<type>.yaml
```

:::

#### Device index

```yaml
remote_controller:
  type: joystick
  available_mode: all
lms151:
  type: lidar
  available_mode: all
septentrio:
  type: gps
  available_mode: all
xsens:
  type: imu
  available_mode: all
front:
  type: camera
  available_mode: none
cultivator:
  type: implement
  available_mode: simulation
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

#### Configurable fields

::: {.config-table}

| Section | Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| device entry | `<name>` | Device instance name |
| device entry | `type` | Selects the device family |
| device entry | `available_mode` | Selects launch modes |
| device file | `<name>.<type>.yaml` | Matching meta-description file |

:::

::: {.config-table}

| Supported device type | Configuration file |
| --- | --- |
| `joystick` | `<name>.joystick.yaml` |
| `gps` | `<name>.gps.yaml` |
| `imu` | `<name>.imu.yaml` |
| `lidar` | `<name>.lidar.yaml` |
| `camera` | `<name>.camera.yaml` |
| `arm` | `<name>.arm.yaml` |
| `implement` | `<name>.implement.yaml` |

:::

::: {.config-table}

| Available mode | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `all` | Launched in every mode |
| `live` | Real robot only |
| `simulation` | Simulation modes only |
| `simulation_gazebo` | Gazebo only |
| `none` | Declared but disabled |

:::

:::
:::

## Joystick configuration

::: {.columns .config-slide}
::: {.column width="50%"}

#### Configuration file

::: {.config-path}

```text
config/
  robot/
    devices.yaml
    devices/
      remote_controller.joystick.yaml
```

:::

#### Meta-description

```yaml
name: "joystick"
launch:
  - include:
      file: "$(find-pkg-share romea_joystick_meta_bringup)/profile/joy.launch.py"
      if: $(eval "'$(var manufacturer)' != 'any'")
  - include:
      file: "$(find-pkg-share romea_joystick_meta_bringup)/profile/pynput_teleop.launch.py"
      if: $(eval "'$(var manufacturer)' == 'any'")
configuration:
  manufacturer: microsoft
  model: xbox
  rate: 10
records:
  joy: true
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

#### Configurable fields

::: {.config-table}

| Section | Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `launch` | included files | Calls joystick profiles/files |
| `configuration` | `manufacturer` | Selects joystick family |
| `configuration` | `model` | Selects joystick mapping |
| `configuration` | `rate` | Expected joystick data frequency |
| `records` | topic flags | Joystick topics saved in a bag |

:::

::: {.config-table}

| Manufacturer | Model | Version |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `microsoft` | `xbox` | - |
| `sony` | `dualshock4` | - |
| `any` | `keyboard` | - |

## GPS configuration

::: {.columns .config-slide}
::: {.column width="50%"}

#### Configuration file

::: {.config-path}

```text
config/
  robot/
    devices.yaml
    devices/
      septentrio.gps.yaml
```
:::

#### Meta-description

```yaml
name: gps
launch:
  - include:
      file: "$(find-pkg-share romea_gps_meta_bringup)/profile/romea_gps_serial_driver.launch.py"
      if: $(eval "'$(var mode)' == 'live'")
  - include:
      file: "$(find-pkg-share romea_gps_meta_bringup)/profile/gz_bridge.launch.py"
      if: $(eval "'$(var mode)' == 'simulation_gazebo'")
configuration:
  manufacturer: septentrio
  model: asterx
  rate: 10
  dual_antenna: true
location:
  parent_link: "base_link"
  xyz: [0.0, 0.0, 1.5] # m
records:
  nmea_sentence: true
  gps_fix: false
```
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

#### Configurable fields

::: {.config-table}

| Section | Field | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `launch` | included files | Calls launch profiles/files |
| `configuration` | `manufacturer` | Selects supported manufacturer |
| `configuration` | `model` | Selects supported model |
| `configuration` | `version` | Selects supported version (optional) |
| `configuration` | `rate` | Expected GPS data frequency |
| `configuration` | `dual_antenna` | Enables heading computation |
| `location` | `xyz` | Antenna position relative to `base_link` |
| `records` | topic flags | GPS topics saved in a bag |

:::


::: {.config-table}

| Manufacturer | Model | Version |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `septentrio` | `asterx` | - |
| `ublox` | `evk_m8` | - |
| `drotek` | `f9p` | - |
| `ashtech` | `proflex_800` | - |

:::

::: {.config-table}

| Launch profile | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `gz_bridge` | ROS2 Gazebo bridge |
| `nmea_navsat_driver` | ROS2 Generic NMEA driver |
| `ntrip_client` | ROS2 RTK corrections publisher |
| `romea_gps_serial_driver` | ROMEA Serial receiver driver |
| `romea_gps_tcp_driver` | ROMEA TCP receiver driver |
| `localisation_plugin` | ROMEA localisation plugin |

:::

## Manipulator configuration

::: {.columns .config-slide}
::: {.column width="50%"}

#### Configuration file

::: {.config-path}

```text
config/
  robot/
    devices.yaml
    devices/
      ur10.arm.yaml
```

:::

#### Meta-description

```yaml
name: arm
launch:
  - include:
      file: "$(find-pkg-share romea_arm_meta_bringup)/profile/ur.launch.py"
      arg:
        - {name: ip, value: "1.1.1.1"}
configuration:
  manufacturer: universal_robots
  model: ur
  version: "10"
  control_rate: 500  # Hz
  home_joint_positions:
    shoulder_pan_joint: 0.0 # °
    shoulder_lift_joint: -80 # °
    elbow_joint: 0.0 # °
    wrist_1_joint: -90 # °
    wrist_2_joint: 0.0 # °
    wrist_3_joint: 0.0 # °
location:
  parent_link: "base_link"
  xyz: [2.02, 0.0, 0.54] # m
  rpy: [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] # °
records:
  joint_states: false
```
:::

## Robot launch flow

::: {.launch-flow-slide}

![](img/03_robot/robot_launch_flow.svg){.robot-launch-flow-diagram}

TIRREX starts from `base.yaml`, `devices.yaml` and the matching device files. It resolves the selected meta-descriptions, generates one robot meta-description, then delegates the runtime composition to ROMEA robot and simulation meta-bringup packages.

:::
